[[Image:River Manetherendrelle map.png|thumb|right|200px|Location]]

The '''River Manetherendrelle''' is one of the primary waterways of the [[Westlands]]. Together with its major tributary, the [[Arinelle]], this river dominates much of the central-western region of the continent and keeps those lands fertile.

The Manetherendrelle itself rises in the [[Mountains of Mist]] at the extreme south-western tip of the [[Two Rivers]] district of [[Andor]]. Its initial course along the southern border of the Two Rivers is marked by rapids, which causes the water to foam and gives the river its local name of the White River.  The White River is the southernmost of the waterflows that flanks the [[Two Rivers]] region.{{ref|{{twotc}}, White River}} Although it has no crossing during modern times, the [[Forest of Shadows]] on the opposite far bank was also part of Manetheren must have been reachable by some means. In fact, a road extends south beyond [[Deven Ride]] that seems to end nowhere, but may have once led to a bridge.

The [[Tarendrelle]] joins the Manetherendrelle further east before it is also joined by the [[Arinelle]] some distance south of [[Whitebridge]]. The river then turns south and flows for several hundred miles through [[Altara]], along the border of [[Murandy]] and through [[Illian]] before meeting the [[Sea of Storms]] at the [[Illian (city)|City of Illian]].

Between the Manetherendrelle and Arinelle, it is possible to sail from [[Maradon]], the capital of [[Saldaea]], all the way to Illian, a distance of approximately three thousand miles.
